title: Grade 7 French — Tue, Jun 17
description: L'imparfait — Day 2 of 5: Regular verbs in imparfait — parler, finir, prendre
subject: french

questions.question: Complete the conjugation table for 'parler' in imparfait. What is the 'ils' form?
questions.explanation: Ils/elles form of imparfait uses -aient. parl- + -aient = ils parlaient (they were speaking).

questions.question: Translate: 'We were studying' (étudier → stem: étudi-)
questions.explanation: Stem: étudi- + -ions → nous étudiions. Note the double 'i' (stem ends in 'i' + endings -ions). We were studying = nous étudiions.

questions.question: Which sentence is in l'imparfait?
options: Elle mangeait une pomme chaque jour.
questions.explanation: Elle mangeait = she was eating / she used to eat (imparfait). The key is the -ait ending and the ongoing/habitual meaning.

questions.question: Translate into French (imparfait): 'You (tu) used to read every evening.'
questions.explanation: lire → nous lisons → stem: lis- → tu lisais. Chaque soir = every evening. Tu lisais chaque soir = You used to read every evening.

questions.question: Conjugate 'prendre' in imparfait for 'nous'. (nous prenons → stem: pren-)
questions.explanation: pren- + -ions → nous prenions (we were taking). Both options A and B look the same — the answer is nous prenions.

questions.question: Which verb's imparfait stem is 'buvai-'? (boire → nous buvons → stem: buv-)
questions.explanation: Boire (to drink) → nous buvons → stem buv- → je buvais, tu buvais, il buvait... etc.

questions.question: Fill in: 'Quand j'étais enfant, je ___ (jouer) au football.' (habitual past)
questions.explanation: Habitual past action = imparfait. je jouais = I used to play / I was playing (when I was a child).

questions.question: Conjugate 'choisir' (to choose) in imparfait for 'elle'. (nous choisissons → stem: choisiss-)
questions.explanation: choisiss- + -ait → elle choisissait (she was choosing / she used to choose).

questions.question: What does 'ils chantaient' mean?
options: They were singing / they used to sing
questions.explanation: Ils chantaient is the imparfait 3rd plural form of chanter. It means 'they were singing' (ongoing past) or 'they used to sing' (habitual past).

questions.question: Translate: 'He was speaking French.' (parler → parl-)
questions.explanation: parl- + -ait → il parlait. Il parlait français = He was speaking French (ongoing past action).

questions.question: Conjugate 'attendre' (to wait) in imparfait for 'je'. (nous attendons → stem: attend-)
Which of these is the CORRECT full conjugation of 'parler' in imparfait?
options: je parlais, tu parlais, il parlait, nous parlions, vous parliez, ils parlaient
je parlais, tu parlas, il parla, nous parlâmes, vous parlâtes, ils parlèrent
je parlais, tu parlais, il parlait, nous parlions, vous parlaient, ils parliez
je parle, tu parles, il parle, nous parlons, vous parlez, ils parlent
questions.explanation: Option A is the correct full imparfait conjugation of parler. Option B is the passé simple (literary), C has mixed up endings, D is present tense.

questions.question: Translate: 'You (vous) were eating dinner.' (manger → mange-)
questions.explanation: mange- + -iez → vous mangiez. Vous mangiez le dîner = You were eating dinner.

questions.question: Identify the mistake: 'Nous finissions nos devoirs chaque soir.'
options: finissions is wrong — should be finissait
finissions is wrong — should be finissons
There is no mistake — this is correct imparfait
finissions is wrong — should be finissiez
questions.explanation: Nous finissions is the correct imparfait form of finir for nous: finiss- + -ions = finissions. There is no mistake.
